introText: AI Engineer specializing in production-grade LLM applications, multi-agent swarms, stateful RAG architectures, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT). Graduate of BCA (77.4% First Division) and Minor in AI & Data Science from CCE, IIT Mandi (CGPA 8.44/10). Combining deep systems engineering (Rust, C, Linux PAM, POSIX) with enterprise-grade reliability and client operations.
missionStatement: To build high-performance, resilient AI systems that eliminate cloud vendor lock-in, deliver sub-150ms real-time interactions, and bring privacy-first agentic intelligence directly to production environments.

capabilities.title: Stateful Agentic Orchestration
capabilities.description: Building resilient multi-agent graphs with LangGraph, cyclic supervisor routing, async PostgreSQL state management, and long-term memory.

capabilities.title: Sub-150ms Edge & Speech Pipelines
capabilities.description: Optimizing local voice activity detection (VAD), client-side speech inference, Rust/WASM, and ONNX Runtime execution for seamless voice loops.

capabilities.title: PEFT, Fine-Tuning & 3-Tier LLMOps
capabilities.description: Distilling synthetic instruction datasets, 4-bit NF4 QLoRA adaptation, vLLM serving, and automated regression testing (LangSmith, Langfuse, RAGAS).

capabilities.title: Decoupled Systems & Production Backends
capabilities.description: Developing Unix domain socket daemons, low-level Linux authentication modules, and containerized async FastAPI & Node.js microservices.

beyondCodeParagraphs: Before moving full-time into artificial intelligence systems, my academic background included political science and economics at Symbiosis School for Liberal Arts (SSLA). This grounding gives me a sharp lens on systemic incentives, macro trade balances, and technological governance.

When I am not training models or architecting stateful agent graphs, you can find me experimenting with minimalist Linux tiling setups (Hyprland / Arch), studying cognitive spaced repetition (FSRS / SM-2 algorithms), or diving deep into literature across economic theory and classic sci-fi worldbuilding.
quote: The best AI systems are fast, local, and invisible: users forget they are even there.
